title: Kosovo Elects President After Opposition Agrees To Last-Minute Deal

title: Iran's Medicine Shortages Fuel Black Market For Essential Drugs

title: Police, Protesters Clash In Pristina As Lawmakers Debate Bill On War Crimes Court
content: Police fired tear gas at protesters outside the parliament building in Kosovo's capital, Pristina, on October 5. The protesters were demanding that lawmakers pass legislation that would limit the decisions of a special war crimes tribunal by imposing caps on prison terms for convicted criminals.
